This corpus is fixture data for the documents adapter. It is small on purpose:
every file here exists to make one behavior observable.

# Corpus Guide

The files below are a miniature project archive. Nothing in them is real
documentation for anything.

## Layout

Project packets live under `projects/`, one directory per project. The first
path segment is the project, which the adapter keeps as routing metadata.

## Conventions

Headings are ATX only. A section runs from its heading to the next heading of
any level.
